data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘G-Z-R’, meaning ‘to overcome, to be victorious, and to be triumphant’. In Islamic history, the name Guzeer was given to warriors and leaders who were known for their courage and strength. The name Guzeer carries the meaning “Victorious, Triumphant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Guzeer usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious, triumphant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
